title: Keep proposal data parallel to operational TRANSIT_LINES
rationale: VR-001 should not migrate or break the existing routing data. Proposal data maps existing operating statuses to operational only when records are later derived from live service, and keeps geometry as [lon, lat] with Google Maps adapter helpers for rendering.

name: Transit proposal validation strategy
description: Proposal validation returns path-specific issues and explicitly catches missing geometry, missing provenance, missing status, invalid status values, invalid LineString coordinates, and invalid station coordinates before Google Maps overlay rendering.

name: Transit proposal schema v1
description: VR-001 proposal records use TransitProposalDataset schemaVersion 1.0.0 with required id, name, kind, status, mode, GeoJSON LineString geometry, provenance, and confidence fields plus optional stations, timeline, style, rendering, freight metadata, notes, and tags.

name: Transit proposal import pipeline
description: Import proposal datasets through validated source manifests, fail fast on malformed IDs, dates, confidence, provenance, and duplicate proposal IDs, then emit Google Maps-ready overlay inputs without map renderer changes.

name: Visionary proposal classification
description: TransitProposal records carry official, commentary_summary, advocacy_derived, or speculative classification plus uncertainty source notes, and validation prevents unofficial concepts from entering the official future layer.

name: Freight corridor proposal metadata
description: Freight corridors reuse TransitProposal with freight owner/operator, track usage, electrification, source references, conversion scenarios, and suitability metadata so passenger-conversion scenarios remain clearly separate from Google Maps transit routes.

name: Official future transit dataset batch
description: VR-105 added the first bounded official LA-area Future Transit dataset in src/data/officialFutureTransitProposals.ts. Included records are Metro East San Fernando Valley LRT, Southeast Gateway Line, K Line Extension to Torrance, Eastside Transit Corridor Phase 2, North Hollywood to Pasadena BRT, and Vermont Transit Corridor BRT; the existing D Line seed remains in the base source. Sources are official Metro project pages and an LA Metro construction notice, each with accessedAt 2026-05-19. Geometry is Google Maps overlay geometry only and is marked geometrySource: approximate unless an official GIS alignment is later imported; station markers may be representative subsets or transfer anchors and must document assumptions. Excluded records are speculative, advocacy-only, already operational, or records that require schema or renderer changes outside the current import boundary.

outcomes.test_results: npm run issue:gate -- VR-105 passed, including npm run quality and strict Playwright @VR-105.

name: LA freight rail corridor source batch
description: VR-402 imported four LA freight corridor records from ACTA, Port of LA, FRA NARN/data.gov, Caltrans rail network, BNSF, Union Pacific, Anacostia/Pacific Harbor Line, and UP short-line sources. Corridor geometry is simplified VeloRail centerline geometry for Google Maps overlays, with source/license notes on every proposal and known gaps documented in docs/architecture/freight-rail-corridor-dataset.md.

name: Durable GTFS parser and IndexedDB store boundary
description: VR-503 keeps static GTFS as app-owned schedule/source data while Google Maps remains the rendering/routing surface. The import boundary is parseGTFSFeedFiles/parseGTFSZip plus GTFSParseError validation for routes, stops, trips, stop_times, calendar, and calendar_dates; storeGTFSData persists stops/routes/trips/trip stop sequences/calendars and metadata with 24h Metro Rail and 7d Metro Bus/Metrolink TTLs.

name: Official future transit update workflow
description: veloRail-d29c adds OFFICIAL_FUTURE_TRANSIT_REVIEW_POLICY and source watch targets for the official LA future dataset plus npm run validate:official-future-transit. The workflow checks official-only future records, source URLs, accessed/review dates, opening-year and station-list drift coverage, and a 90-day review cadence with stale-after-120-day validation.

name: Routing comparison metrics versus Google Maps
description: VR-504 adds routingComparison.ts with injectable VeloRail and Google baseline providers. Reports compare fastest routes by duration, distance, transfers, per-mode split, and scenario availability while explicitly marking Google unsupported future or hypothetical scenarios instead of overclaiming parity.

name: Freight passenger conversion scenario model
description: VR-404/VR-405/veloRail-967a derive speculative converted_passenger proposal records from sourced freight corridors, preserve freight owner/operator/source metadata, attach explicit station assumptions, and render them through the nationalized overlay group rather than treating them as official service.

outcomes.test_results: npm run quality passed after merge; browser gate selectors added for nationalized overlay metadata.

name: Visionary overlay registry and rendering
description: VR-202/VR-203 keep visionary transit concepts in a dedicated registry that validates speculative/provenance language, renders through the visionary overlay group, and uses clear non-official disclaimer metadata so users cannot confuse concepts with funded or agency-approved projects.

outcomes.test_results: npm run quality passed after merge; browser metadata coverage exercises visionary legend and panel copy.

name: Visionary bundle provenance workflow
description: VR-204/VR-205/VR-206 keep visionary records in the dedicated registry with pre-use Vision overlay disclaimer copy, internal/source provenance notes, speculative legend labels, and an editorial checklist that requires classification, geometry notes, uncertainty, source notes, copyright caution, Mulch, and Canopy review.

outcomes.test_results: npm run test, lint, typecheck, build passed; strict browser preflight for @VR-204/@VR-406 passed.

name: Initial LA nationalized rail scenario
description: VR-407 packages the first bounded nationalized rail review scenario from generated converted-passenger records: Alameda Corridor South Alameda, BNSF LA to San Bernardino, and UP LA to Inland Empire. Pacific Harbor Line stays excluded as freight context only until a sourced passenger concept exists.

outcomes.test_results: npm run test, lint, typecheck, build passed; strict browser preflight for @VR-204/@VR-406 passed.

name: Fallback surface-speed route estimates
description: When Google Routes falls back to OSRM geometry for bike or walk rail options, use VeloRail-owned surface speeds for duration estimates instead of OSRM duration values; OSRM can return identical or unrealistic biking and walking durations.

name: D Line Section 1 overlay retirement
description: When a Metro segment opens, keep opened service out of the Future Transit overlay: update the current TRANSIT_LINES route, trim proposal geometry/stations to only still-future segments, refresh Metro provenance, and add regression tests for omitted opened stations.

name: Overlay anchor alignment contracts
description: For overlay alignment fixes, treat visible proposal handoffs as coordinate contracts: current line station anchors in TRANSIT_LINES, legacy stations.js/transit_data.js, and proposal geometry/station records must agree for transfer anchors such as Wilshire/La Cienega, Slauson, Redondo Beach, Expo/Vermont, Vermont/Athens, Expo/Sepulveda, and future-to-future links like Sepulveda to D Line Westwood/UCLA. Add mapOverlayRegistry tests for these anchor contracts and keep strict browser titles tagged with the Seeds issue.
